title: stylidium angustifolium subsp. glaucifolium
intro: Stylidium angustifolium subsp. glaucifolium, commonly known as Trigger Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Stylidiaceae. It is a native Australian plant known for its unique trigger-like mechanism that fires seeds into the air when disturbed. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are believed to possess therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
